Description

Dorsal horn neurons express β2 adrenoceptors, which couple to Gs and raise cAMP when descending noradrenaline reaches them. In animal models, β2 receptor agonists given over weeks relieve neuropathic allodynia, but the cells that carry this effect are not settled. Their role in OA pain has not been studied.
